description: A single violet point, flat-faced and flawless. Amethyrn grazes on these and swallows the ones it likes.
lore: You do not mine these. You follow. [[monsters/crystal_horn|Amethyrn]] eats what it likes and passes what it does not, and a man walking a day behind a feeding bull can make a season off the road without swinging at anything. The flat faces are why the trade pays over the odds: a grazed point comes up already tabled, and a cutter who has not had to cut charges as though he had. There is a follower on the north fells who has kept to one bull for eleven years. He knows its temper, its slow circuit, where it beds. He stopped calling it prospecting a while ago. Asked what he calls it now, he said the bull was easier company than a fire, because a fire wants you to talk.
